rules: Do not merge a PR solely to make migration easier.
Never replay committed generated outputs from a divergent branch without rebuilding on target.
Assets/specs may transfer independently of their original room/navigation implementation.
Every replayed PR becomes a new Kona.m PR with fresh before/after evidence.
Any PR not listed is reviewed individually before branch deletion/archive; absence is not permission to discard.
